delivery.format: PNG with true alpha transparency (no fake checkerboard), then also export .webp with alpha
delivery.size: 2048x2048, subject centred, ~70% of frame, 8% empty margin, no shadow on ground, no background, no text

shared_style.look: luxury fragrance ingredient still life, macro product photography, subject floating in air, isolated
shared_style.lighting: single warm key light from upper left (amber, 3200K), soft cool rim light from behind right, deep specular highlights, rich micro-texture
shared_style.camera: 100mm macro, f/8, tack sharp throughout, slight 3/4 angle
shared_style.grade: rich, warm, slightly desaturated, cinematic; matches existing VASA scent elements (bergamot-peel, cedar-shavings-branch, vetiver-roots, almonds-open-shell, tuberose-flowers, tonka-beans-split-pod)
shared_style.negative: background, floor, table, text, logo, watermark, hands, bottle, cartoon, CGI plastic look, oversaturation, blur, cropped subject

images.prompt: Three fresh lavender sprigs crossing loosely, violet florets with tiny dew droplets, a few loose florets drifting off, velvety stems
A short pear blossom branch with clusters of white five-petal flowers, pink-tipped anthers, two young green leaves, one petal falling
One fully open white gardenia flower with creamy waxy petals and two glossy dark green leaves, a single water droplet on a petal
A loose sculptural mound of dark muscovado brown sugar crystals mid-spill, a few crystals scattering in the air, glistening amber facets
Two dark resin-rich agarwood (oud) chips, deep brown-black with glossy resin veins and fibrous grain, one slightly angled above the other
A small cluster of golden frankincense resin tears with one glowing ember tear releasing a thin elegant ribbon of white smoke curling upward

optional_upgrade.note: Only if you want photoreal bottles instead of the procedural 3D ones. Transparent PNG, 2048x2048, one per fragrance, straight-on front view, identical framing across all four.
optional_upgrade.prompt: The real VASA 50ml bottle photographed straight-on on pure transparent background, studio packshot, soft even light, crisp glass edges, liquid colour true to the product
